report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Kavya Reddy | Age: 19
Body Temperature at Scene: 22.2°C | Ambient Temperature: 30.4°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 12.8 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Cranial: Blunt force trauma with {severity} fracture [SEVERE]
  2. Upper Limb: Defensive bruising on forearms [MODERATE]
  3. Thoracic: Multiple rib fractures with internal hemorrhage [SEVERE]
  4. Facial: Periorbital ecchymosis bilateral [MODERATE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): None detected

RIGOR MORTIS: Full rigor present in all muscle groups.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed pattern suggesting body repositioned post-mortem.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a premeditated assault by an attacker known to the victim. Toxicological findings show no intoxicating substances.
